wiki.title: Greg Elkins
wiki.extract: Gregory Allen Elkins (born October 10, 1964) is an American politician from Kentucky. He is a Republican who has represented District 28 in the Kentucky Senate since June 8, 2023. Elkins won a special election on May 16, 2023. He is also a businessman and CEO of a waste management company. He previously served two terms as a Clark County Magistrate in Winchester, Kentucky.
